extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: VAP-Data is a dataset for semantic-controlled video generation containing over 100,000 curated paired video samples across 100 semantic conditions.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian; Xin Chen; Zenan Li; Tiancheng Zhi; Shen Sang; Linjie Luo; Qiang Xu
extraction.citeAs: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu. Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation. 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: 2K high-quality reference images were collected from the Internet, and then Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs were used to create paired videos.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping; Web API; Software Collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: High-quality reference images from the Internet and visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: the semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models; may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., if the source models are poor at generating hands, VAP will likely not learn to generate hands well from this data)
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, “deepfake” content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset includes images of men, women, and children collected from the Internet. Default content filters are used to block clearly harmful categories such as sexual content, explicit violence, and hate symbols.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: We then use Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU [ 68] and Kling [ 40]) and community LoRAs [ 11] to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates
